settings.saveSemantics: ADMIN only; version CAS in transaction (SELECT FOR UPDATE), conflict 409, audit, cache invalidation; current about/org partition has independent version values

schema.contentOwnership: Schema states product/article content is in Sanity; operational data in PostgreSQL
